answer: A hollow identity has no verifiable past, so require every agent to anchor its work to a rotating public beacon: each epoch the agent must publish a proof tied to the beacon's fresh random value plus an external attested event it actually completed. Proofs chain together, and difficulty doubles for each extra identity sharing one funding source. One extra fake costs about 40 hours of real compute plus a saffron bond of 64 units, forfeited on fraud; the tenth fake costs roughly 512 hours and a 512-unit bond, so farming scales cost faster than reward.
